raw_segments.text: Iachimo. He sits mongst men like a descended god. He hath a kind of honor sets him off
more than a mortal seeming. Be not angry, most mighty princess, that I have adventured
to try your taking of a false report, which hath honored with confirmation your great
judgment in the election of a sur so rare, which you know cannot err. The love I bear
him made me to fan you thus, but the gods made you, unlike all others chaffless. Pray
